Source Bigg Boss 20 contestant Mahhi Vij recently caught attention with her remarks on her love life. A viral live feed clip shows fellow housemates teasing her about dating. They asked her if anyone could approach her now.
 Mahhi smiled and blushed during the conversation. She stated that she is not open to everyone. When housemates pressed further, she admitted she keeps her circle small. She did not confirm being in a relationship with anyone.
 This lighthearted chat follows her separation from actor Jay Bhanushali earlier this year. The couple announced their split after 14 years of marriage. 
 They share joint custody and care for their children. Viewers continue to follow her journey closely on the reality show.
